name: Workflow
description: Launch a workflow with multiple agents working in parallel or pipeline. The workflow runs asynchronously — this tool returns immediately with a run_id. When the workflow completes, you'll receive a notification with the result summary. Use the workflow when you need to orchestrate multiple agents for complex tasks.

script.description: The workflow script (JavaScript ESM). Uses primitives: agent(), parallel(), pipeline(), phase(), log(), workflow(). Either `script` or `scriptPath` must be provided.

args.description: Optional arguments passed to the workflow script.

budgetTotal.description: Maximum total token budget for this workflow. Omit for no explicit budget.

maxAgents.description: Fail-safe host limit for live agent attempts. Resume cache hits are not charged.

maxToolCalls.description: Fail-safe host limit for tool calls reported by completed live agents.

maxElapsedMs.description: Fail-safe host wall-clock limit in milliseconds.

resumeFromRunId.description: If provided, resume the workflow from the given run ID. The journal from the previous run will be loaded for cache-hit.

name.description: Optional workflow name (for display). If omitted, extracted from script's meta.name.

strictPreflight.description: Reject unless workflow primitives and graph can be statically validated. The current engine cannot provide that proof.

writeIntent.description: Declarative repository write ownership. Omit only for legacy runs; omitted intent can never produce a deliverable result.

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file (alternative to inline script). If provided, the file is read and used as the workflow script.
